sources.what: LIBERO-plus, the simulator code and all its task files (a fork of LIBERO; the base tasks' files are byte-identical to LIBERO @ 8f1084e3132a39270c3a13ebe37270a43ece2a01)
LIBERO-plus assets (new objects, textures, scenes), assets.zip, sha256 96764a4bfbdaea98d4411598caeab235458318fe0f549611b93d1a323027b3cf, 6,395,849,578 bytes, unzipped into libero/libero/

build: create a Python 3.8.13 environment (LIBERO's; LIBERO-plus says its use is identical to LIBERO's, README L42)
clone the code at the revision; pip install -e .; system packages libexpat1, libfontconfig1-dev, libpython3-stdlib, libmagickwand-dev; pip install -r extra_requirements.txt (README L52-60)
download assets.zip at the revision, check its sha256, unzip into libero/libero/ (README L62-78)
point the package's config at this checkout's libero/libero folders
check: python -c "from libero.libero import benchmark; s = benchmark.get_benchmark_dict()['libero_goal'](); print(s.n_tasks)"
tried_on_the_test_host_2026_11_12: code: git clone at 4976dc30 (0.15 GB); assets.zip at dd2bd61b: 5.96 GB, sha256 equal to the hub's; unzipped it is 8.95 GB in 457,675 files under a long build path (inspire/hdd/.../LIBERO-plus-0/assets): move that assets folder to libero/libero/assets
no system ImageMagick on the host and no apt: ImageMagick 7.1.2 from conda-forge with a standalone micromamba 2.0.5 (0.57 GB); MAGICK_HOME set to that prefix

Python: a venv with --system-site-packages over an existing LIBERO-PRO simulator environment (Python 3.8, numpy 1.22.4, robosuite 1.4.1, mujoco 3.2.3) plus Wand and scikit-image 0.21.0 (0.07 GB); LIBERO-plus put first on PYTHONPATH, not pip-installed
a LIBERO config pointing at the checkout's bddl_files, init_files and assets; the base tasks are not entries of LIBERO-plus's suite lists, their files are LIBERO's own
